results.pair_summary: Doc A defines the logical IR specification for the Chron-LLM agent, detailing domain types (Event, WorldlineID), algorithms, and kernel invariants. Doc B specifies the physical FFI bindings to llama.cpp, mapping high-level operations to native C functions and pointers. They share operation names but operate at distinct abstraction layers.
results.integration_rationale: Doc A represents the semantic contract and kernel-managed logic (IR), whereas Doc B implements the Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) for native execution. Keeping them separate preserves the Delta3 Kernel's required boundary between logical correctness (Events/Worldlines) and physical implementation details (memory/layout). Merging would conflate high-level semantics with low-level FFI constraints.
